global_layers.prior_automated_estimate: see halftone_pitch.json (FFT of full-res frames every 2 s). Square dot grid, axis-aligned (0/90 degrees). Pitch ~4.2 px for most of the film (e.g. f24, f5200), but visibly coarse ~7.3-8 px in the white finale looks (f7000) and some mid sections; the automated estimate is noisy where content has strong periodic structure.
